label: MEASURED

bound.fault_model: single-cycle bit flip of any gate output or flop Q

note: BOUNDED, NOT UNBOUNDED: verdict holds only for <= 3 single-cycle bit-flip faults (gate outputs and flop Q) within 4 cycles on this synthesized netlist. It says nothing about more faults, longer runs, other fault types (stuck-at, multi-bit/spatial, clock/voltage effects), or physical feasibility. Toy design; modelled faults.

explanation.summary: SINGLE POINT OF FAILURE: the state register bit `A.sboxw[5]` can be flipped for one cycle (cycle 2) and the state/output word then reads as the accept value.
explanation.fix_pattern: Encode state with Hamming distance greater than the fault budget (e.g. sparse one-hot-ish codes), add a parity/redundant shadow register compared every cycle, and make illegal codes latch a sticky FAIL state.
